notes: Shaded rendering of real LRO NAC DTM elevation (not a photo). Crop is a 5.12km square at native 5 m/px, centered on the pixel of Lunokhod 2's parked position (a surveyed coordinate from LROC post 699, not a proxy). Goal is the parked rover ("Lunokhod 2 (parked since 1973)"); spawn is the lowest-slope point 1.5-3km south of it, chosen along the rover's real recorded approach direction (post 699: "Rover tracks extend north to the final parking place", i.e. the historic drive came from the south). Luna 21's landing site (26.005N, 30.406E) is ~39km away (the real driving distance Lunokhod 2 covered) and falls outside this crop; its pixel in the full raster has DTM elevation -2687.9m vs LROC post 699's cited -2769m. mask.bin marks nodata-filled cells (rendered as a hatched no-data texture in albedo.jpg/preview.png); spawn and goal are kept >= 20px clear of them. The rover model in-engine is an illustrative period-accurate silhouette, not a survey model.
maskMeaning: 1 = no orbital data (filled), treat as impassable
